cubecraftplus.general.title: General
cubecraftplus.general.chestfinder.title: Lobby Chest Finder
cubecraftplus.general.chestfinder.toolti: Looks for the hidden lobby chest when you join a lobby or it's announced, and posts its coordinates in chat.
cubecraftplus.general.chestfinder.highli: Draws a box and a beam on the found chest, visible through walls.

cubecraftplus.general.update.tooltip: Tells you in chat when a new version of CubeCraft+ is out. Applies from the next launch.

cubecraftplus.cubepanion.title: Cubepanion
cubecraftplus.cubepanion.cubesocket.tool: Stays connected to Cubepanion's CubeSocket while you're on CubeCraft. When off, leaderboard submits and player counts stop.
cubecraftplus.cubepanion.leaderboard.too: Sends leaderboards to Cubepanion after paging through every page of one in-game. Requires CubeSocket.
cubecraftplus.cubepanion.gamestats.title: Game Player Counts
cubecraftplus.cubepanion.gamestats.toolt: Reads the player counts on the lobby's game nametags and sends them to Cubepanion. Requires CubeSocket.
cubecraftplus.autovote.title: Auto Vote
cubecraftplus.autovote.silent.tooltip: Votes in the background, so the voting menus never open on screen.
